blocks.title: Nine groups, one signature
blocks.deck: Everyone this touches, grouped by where they work. Filter to see who is in the trial.

blocks.rule: Nobody gets a new job. What changes is when they confirm something. The Head of Operations signs off the new order.

sheets.title: Head of Operations
sheets.text: Approves the new order of the day. Without that sign-off, the old order comes back on the first busy day.
sheets.entry: Who is your Head of Operations?

sheets.title: Doctors
sheets.text: The pushback sits here. Naming a date a day early is a clinical call. A date to check is easier than one to make.

lines.label: Asked
lines.value: Check a date on the round

sheets.title: Medical Supervisory team
sheets.text: One round at 5 PM of the beds likely to free tomorrow. That is the new part of their day.

sheets.title: ICU doctors
sheets.text: Name the ICU patients likely to move to a ward, by 1 PM.

sheets.title: Admissions desk
sheets.text: Calls each patient in for a time. Confirms dates back into the plan.
sheets.entry: How many people work the desk?

sheets.title: Discharge team
sheets.text: Gets a time to have each bed ready, instead of a surprise.
sheets.entry: Who runs discharges on the wards?

sheets.title: Billing
sheets.text: Runs one new report: last bill and first bill against the same bed.

sheets.title: OPD doctors
sheets.text: Write the date, the procedure and the likely stay on the slip.

sheets.title: IT team
sheets.text: Gives read access, about two weeks of work. Then nothing daily.

blocks.label: Where the pushback sits
blocks.value: A date named a day early
blocks.sub: Not the speaking on the round. Show a date to check and it holds. Ask for one and it will not.
